catalogueCoverage.scope: Every visible station level and all 73 tracker entries from GZW Hideout as accessed on 2026-10-25. Compared all 15 stations and 36 upgrade rows with the community spreadsheet and Fandom wiki. Differences in costs, numbering and benefits are disclosed; this is not an official exhaustive in-game catalogue.

notes: Room structure is official. Detailed recipe quantities and capability prerequisites are community reports.
All 73 tracker entries are included, but one is US Dollars. There are 72 physical material entries, and 46 distinct physical materials used in the 36 listed station upgrades.
Categories follow the source. Electrical Parts, CPU, Circuit Board and software are classified as crafting material even though station upgrades also consume them.

The full tracker page aggregates station upgrades with additional crafting/production needs; its total-required counts must not be used as station-upgrade totals. Derive goals from the per-level recipes.
Listed required resources are material requirements; the source provides no separate reusable-tool designation. Do not assert tools are reusable.
Capabilities labeled +N are source-reported increments. Model accumulated prior levels if computing capability totals; storage capacity is room-specific, power is shared.
Source exposes 19 Laboratory upgrades, 15 Electronics Workshop upgrades and 2 Generator upgrades. Many stations have two levels. Do not fabricate a third level for every station.
Ventilation's second available upgrade is labeled level3 on the primary community source; keep previousLevel1 and disclose conflict with the spreadsheet and Fandom wiki.
US Dollars is separated into each recipe's money field. If retaining it in the item catalogue, label currency distinctly in UI.
Crafting/production ingredient catalogue is included, but their output recipes and unlocks were not extracted; do not imply these recipes are included.

Fandom calls Ventilation System Safety. Missing ingredients and placeholder +x functions are unknown, not zero. See conflicts for the seven recipe-cost differences, repeated Heat Source label, advanced Ventilation numbering, and four storage-capacity differences.
There are 17 flagged source differences. Community-source agreement is corroboration, not independent in-game verification. Do not describe this as official complete 0.5 data.
reviewSummary: Compared all 15 stations and 36 upgrades with the updated Fandom wiki on 25 October 2026. It supports four selected quantities disputed by the spreadsheet, but adds 12 warnings about materials, cash, numbering and storage benefits: 17 flagged differences in total. The wiki history shows today’s edit as a typo; station tables were added on 24 October. Selected recipes remain unchanged pending in-game confirmation.
